div.div:
Notes
*1 Write local, put the cross-cloud dependency on the read side
A write path that crosses clouds couples ingest to the remote API.
*2 A FlexCache Cache cannot take an S3 Access Point
To serve over the S3 API, use a SnapMirror destination.
*3 No line is drawn to a non-AWS service
Network reachability and a working FlexCache are different questions.
